description: Nothing sets the copy state unavailable. A copy on a disk missing, within health.missing_grace or past it, and on a disk the configuration no longer lists, keeps the state it had, ok or surplus: the disk's state says it cannot be read, and its file is unavailable when no other copy can be.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
[[rule]]
label = "single"
path = "**"
replicas = 0

steps.query: SELECT CAST(f.lpath AS TEXT), c.disk_id, c.state, f.state FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id ORDER BY f.lpath, c.disk_id
SELECT CAST(f.lpath AS TEXT), c.disk_id, c.state, f.state FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id ORDER BY f.lpath, c.disk_id
SELECT CAST(f.lpath AS TEXT), c.disk_id, c.state, f.state FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id ORDER BY f.lpath, c.disk_id
